name: print-social-vr-fashion-white-minimal-photo-ad
title: White minimalist VR fashion photo ad with translucent city overlay
whatItIs: A minimalist square ad on a near-white background, showing a smiling woman wearing VR glasses over a faded translucent city-skyline photo, with a bold 'Hello Dear Customer' headline.
whatItMeans: Blending a translucent skyline behind a bright, clean-lit portrait suggests connectivity and scale while staying visually light and airy rather than dark and 'techy.'
techniques: fade a secondary background photo to low opacity so it reads as texture rather than competing imagery
light the hero subject brightly and cleanly to keep a minimalist ad feeling approachable, not stark
reserve a torn-paper corner cutout as a small textural detail against an otherwise flat white field

vocabulary.definition: reducing an element's transparency so it recedes visually behind more prominent foreground content
